title: Does scarcity make food more pleasurable?

source.title: Vesuvius Challenge 2023 Grand Prize announcement
source.location: PHerc. Paris. 4, column −8, lines 10–14 (ending at νομίζομεν)
source.transcription_status: Published preliminary scholarly transcription; not Unscroll OCR
source.attribution: Column image © Vesuvius Challenge; underlying scan: EduceLab-Scrolls / University of Kentucky; papyrus: Institut de France. Published preliminary transcription: Vesuvius papyrology team.
source.relationship_to_experiment: Separate published reading example. Not text recovered by our 50-slice tracing experiment.
source.region_method: Manually located line rectangles on the published column illustration; not word-level or CT-coordinate annotations. Line 14 is excerpted before οὐ γὰρ.

en.text: With food, we do not immediately consider scarce things necessarily more pleasant than plentiful ones.
en.provenance: Unscroll editorial draft based on the published Greek and its accompanying discussion; not the publisher's translation verbatim.
en.review_status: Not independently reviewed by a classical Greek specialist.

ta.text: உணவுகளைப் பொறுத்தவரை, அரிதாகக் கிடைப்பவை மிகுதியாகக் கிடைப்பவற்றைவிட அவசியம் அதிக இன்பம் தருபவை என்று நாம் உடனே கருதுவதில்லை.
ta.provenance: Unscroll Tamil draft conveying the same passage meaning as the English draft; not a published scholarly Tamil translation.
ta.review_status: Not independently reviewed by a Tamil translator or classical Greek specialist.

editorial_note: Underdots mark uncertain letters in the published reading. Accents and word spacing are editorial. The excerpt begins and ends within a longer discussion; no missing text is reconstructed. Translations render the proposed sense, not certainty about every ink stroke.
source_text:
ἐ̣π̣ὶ τῶν βρω̣μ̣άτ̣ων
ο̣ὐ̣κ ἤδ̣η τὰ ϲπάνια
πάντωϲ̣ καὶ ἡδ̣ίω
τῶν δ̣αψιλῶν̣ ε̣ἶναι̣
νομίζ̣ο̣με̣ν·

translations.en: With respect to foods, we do not already suppose the rare things to be in every way even more pleasant than the abundant ones.
translations.ta: உணவுகளைப் பொறுத்தவரை, அரிதானவை மிகுதியானவற்றை விட எல்லா வகையிலும் மேலும் இனிமையானவை என்று நாம் ஏற்கெனவே கருதவில்லை.

recorded_model.notes: Underdots appear under most letters and denote uncertain readings; the translation follows the letters as given without restoring or adding words. The negation ou-k with nomizomen is kept as a negative statement, and hedio ... ton dapsilon is kept as a comparative. Lunate sigma in spania is read as sigma. No square brackets or editorial question marks occur in the supplied text; the final middle dot is punctuation and is not read as a question mark.
